The main takeaway from our work is that

fish can accumulate pharmaceuticals from surface waters at environmentally relevant concentrations and, depending on their physicochemical properties, can distribute these pharmaceuticals to a range of biological compartments, with potential consequences for the health of the fish.
pharmaceuticals can be taken up and distributed into fish biological samples, but the extent of bioconcentration is highly variable and dependent upon molecular properties of pharmaceuticals.
